about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Velar D240 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Velar D240 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre 4-cylinder diesel. It was fitted from 2017 across the L560 generation of the Range Rover Velar, positioned as the high-output 4-cylinder diesel option in the range alongside the D180 and D200. The Ingenium diesel family has a well-documented timing chain pattern across Jaguar Land Rover applications, and the AJ200D is no exception — which is why we replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, and gaskets as standard on every rebuild.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200D engines for every Range Rover Velar D240 on the road.
